mcmod.remote: No git remote configured; no remote invented or unrelated history published

preserved: Source, models, textures, animations and authored documents
All unique artifacts and current/latest releases

git_changes.push_policy: Commit one batch, push it, verify remote SHA, then next batch; no force push or shared history rewriting

safety.backup_type: APFS clones with full SHA256 comparison, plus tracked binary patch and index/refs snapshots

limitations: Logical file totals and du can differ from physically reclaimed APFS blocks.
Only duplicate own artifacts removed; large unique backup, worlds and development caches intentionally retained.
